reason: Missing receipts at month end are a real headache, but I don't handle that stuff myself, my bookkeeper does. I'm not running my company's money trail through a new little bot nobody's heard of until I know it will still be here next year and my bookkeeper says it actually works.
objection: Small apps like this vanish after a year, and then I'm the one who has to sort out the mess and move everything again. Plus my bookkeeper would have to accept it, and I don't want to change how they work.
would_change_my_mind: My bookkeeper or another contractor I know telling me they've used it for a few months without problems.
